notes.title: Demo Hotfix 8 arrives to restore botanical order!
notes.notes: [list][*]New Flower algorithm.[list][*]Lots of changes to flowers to make them less unruly. Can you spot them all?[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now hold Control to replace/override buildings.[/*][*]Hydro Sponge upgrade for Grabber.[list][*]Only works above ground.[/*][/list][/*][*]The world is no longer looping.[list][*]I know a lot of people liked this and had fun abusing it in various ways, but it created too much noise in bug reports.[/*][/list][/*][*]Addressing “stuck on ‘Loading…’” issues.[list][*]There was a loading problem when the game couldn’t detect the number of cores on the user’s computer or when there was not enough logical processors for the concurrency buffer. This has now been fixed.[/*][*]Added significantly more logging to help debug the remaining issues.[/*][*]You can now open the Debug Console from the loading screen. Press the button in the bottom left corner and screenshot or paste the log when reporting loading issues! (Only applicable on Steam. If on itch.io - use the regular DevTools, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+J on Chrome.)[/*][/list][/*][*]Embers from Lava will now ignite Moss/Flowers.[/*][*]When placing block foundations in gaps partially covered by Bedrock a frame foundation will now be built, fully sealing it.[/*][*]You can now press anywhere in the selection after highlighting it with the marquee (or Shift), instead of having to press one of the selected buildings. This applies to copying as well.[/*][*]Additional improvements to make buttons less sticky and more responsive.[list][*]Fixed a dead zone on hotbar and item/building buttons by changing the active pseudo-class.[/*][*]You can now Lock Hotbar in the bottom right corner of the Building and Inventory screens. This will make the buttons activate on mouse “press” instead of “release”, making them much more responsive, but you naturally won’t be able to drag’n’drop until turning it off again.[/*][/list][/*][*]Better support for AZERTY keyboards.[list][*]The hotbar is now mapped to the physical keys instead of numbers.[/*][*]A lot more improvements to better support all kind of keyboard layouts is in the backlog.[/*][/list][/*][*]After selecting a filter, you can now reselect the previous item without having to switch items.[/*][*]When placing 1-tile-wide filters, they will now respect the direction.[/*][*]You can no longer use the Rocket Launcher in the first artifact room.[/*][*]Changed a lot of text and emoji indicators.[/*][*]Wrangled a few rogue pixels in the conveyor graphics.[list][*]Sharp eyes, pixel detectives![/*][/list][/*][*]Increased the circuit breaker when building from 100 to 300.[/*][*]When drag’n’dropping items/buildings within the hotbar the buttons will now swap instead of copy.[/*][*]Autosaves are now bound to your world ID.[/*][*]Rocket Launcher has been nerfed against Redsand.[/*][*]Added icons for [u]everything[/u]. RIP ambiguous [b]C[/b] icons.[/*][*]Flamethrower and Rocket Launcher now have their own graphics.[/*][*]Some fixes to better support widescreen.[list][*]Less windows should now overflow the screen. Still not perfect and you may have to use UI scale to adjust it.[/*][*]Lots more planned to better support all kinds of resolutions.[/*][/list][/*][*]Version is now always displayed in the bottom right corner.[/*][*]Fixed some bugs with Amethelis and filters.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 7 is out!
notes.notes:
[i]Patch notes:[/i]
[list]
[*] You can now phase through buildings while hovering in the air.
[list]
[*] The people have spoken. An overwhelming majority (88%) voted in favor. I personally think the challenge/puzzle of designing a traversable factory is interesting but also very frustrating.
[*] For those who still want to play the old way there's now a "Hard Mode" setting.
[/list]
[*] Snow now vaporizes into Steam when burned.
[*] Queued buildings now block Water, and you can grab Water that is inside them.
[*] Dragging a button onto itself now clicks it instead of canceling.
[list]
[*] This was a big reason the buttons felt "hard" to click.
[/list]
[*] You can no longer zip by placing blocks on top of yourself in rectangular mode.
[*] You can no longer build outside the map in the other dimensions.
[*] Added some fixes to the sound engine to mitigate crashes when too many sounds play at once (let me know if it still happens!).
[*] Many lighting improvements to reduce flickering.
[*] Water no longer deletes lava.
[*] You can now grab particles that are being launched (including ones stuck inside launchers).
[*] You can now grab Steam.
[*] Added some fixes for the "no menu buttons" issue due to corrupted meta data.
[list]
[*] Still haven't figured out the root cause though.
[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug that deleted Gold when the Shaker was full.
[*] New saves will now have much more Redsand on the map.
[*] Refined and clarified many tutorial texts. Also added a new "Tutorial Finished" popup.
[*] Fixed bugs causing issues when pressing "Skip Tutorial" after partially completing it.
[*] The Grabber's Material Scanner upgrade now says "Interacts with:" to clarify what the emojis represent.
[list]
[*] Some people on Linux have reported that emojis are not showing.
[/list]
[*] Added damage type indicator to all weapon descriptions matching the interaction texts.
[*] Added interaction text to Steam and Cinder.
[*] Updated some item descriptions for clarity.
[/list]
The modding community has also been hard at work and has made the first **modloader**. Check the pinned messages in #modding on Discord for installation instructions. Link: https://discord.gg/HJNk5eMnmt


I find it absolutely incredible that the demo hasn’t even been out for two weeks, and we already have people doing some insane stuff with the game! Hats off to the amazing talent in this community!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Hotfix for the Sandustry Demo has been released![/b] Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Most simulation crashes should now be resolved. If your game is still broken or bricked, please export a save and send it to me. It would be a huge help!
[*] You can now descend by pressing S.
[*] The Filter Config can now be closed with Escape.
[*] Actually implemented the key binding for Boost (previously hardcoded to W).
[*] Desktop icon should now be the actual game icon.
[/list]
Unfortunately I wasn't able to fix the issue with the Mouse Back button. If anyone here is an Electron expert, please let me know how I can disable it!

notes.title: Sandustry Playtest + patch notes (0.0.2 to 0.0.5)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828248/1c936b3c9d7f63b6e52b887327eb5490773b7b3d.png[/img]
Hey! Community and I figured it was time to post something here to show that Sandustry is still alive and kicking.

I've been really busy working on the game and released the first playtest on [url=https://lanttogames.itch.io/sandustry]itch.io[/url] back in September. Now the playtest is finally live on Steam as well. You can download it by clicking "Request Access" on the Steam page.

I really appreciate all the amazing feedback and bug reports I’ve received so far. Keep them coming! The easiest way to report something is through Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/DX74sGX]https://discord.gg/DX74sGX[/url]

If you’re interested in what has been cooking since the first playtest went live you can check out the patch notes here:
